answer: Each submission hangs on the ridge of a task receipt, and the zenith is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. By the river of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
